name: Apply Ceiling Finish (Roll Method)
intent: Roll finish coat onto primed ceiling with an 18-inch roller on extension pole. No cut-in module — ceiling finish doesn't cut in to walls because the ceiling-to-wall line is established by the wall painter cutting in to the ceiling later. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with interstage between for QT4/5.
doctrine: Ceiling roll finish baseline (280 SF/hr) is the smooth rate — ~17% slower than wall roll finish for the same overhead reasons that affect prime. FAC_TEXTURE handles the textured slowdown; tune there. No coat_2_rate_multiplier because overhead work doesn't get easier on the second pass — both passes are equally fatiguing. The wall painter establishes the finish cut line later, so this module has no cut-in task.
